card.name: Linking words before teaching or informing verbs
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "and", "will", "you" or "of" that sit right before a verb about educating, instructing, showing or understanding. Mostly in patient-counseling sentences like "Inform patients and caregivers of this potential interaction and educate them".

modes.label: Counseling and
modes.description: The word "and" after an inform-patients clause, just before educate or instruct.
modes.example: Inform patients and caregivers of this potential interaction<< and>> educate them on the signs and symptoms of

modes.label: Other teaching setups
modes.description: Short linking words in general text where something is shown, appreciated or understood next.
modes.example: They'll show<< you>> and your teachers where you need more help

card.writes: It seems to push toward question-like words such as "what" and away from "how".
card.plain: It fires on a small joining word when the sentence is about to say what people should be told or taught.
